digest.component_or_area: reconciler vendor adapter seam, Jira Data Center backend
propositions: ADR 0035 must be amended to document the jira_family sub-seam layer, two parameterizing contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel), and the shared-jira provenance decision with explicit scope deferrals to epic be74 for generalizing jira_key and channel vocabulary

The Backend contract suite certification is conditional on port completeness and type-safety; the TicketTransport protocol declares six members but the reconciler accesses twenty-one distinct members, with twelve absent from DC causing silent failures

RemoteRef.instance is intended design with a known gap; it is never constructed in production code, only in test helpers, and this must be stated plainly with the construction gap tracked rather than asserting existing deployment distinction
The Jira Data Center adapter is a deliberately time-boxed investment with a March 2029 read-only horizon; the durable asset is the family seam architecture rather than the DC-specific code

Configuration documentation must require dedicated least-privilege service accounts with PAT scope to only reconciled projects, document allow_insecure, ca_bundle, and resolved_statuses configuration keys, and validate that documented commands execute successfully against a live instance

Three stale claims in ADR 0035 (line 111 diagram comment, lines 204-205 prose, lines 236-237 Decision item 6, and Consequences section) assert the first real second backend is out of scope; all are falsified because epic e369 landed Jira Data Center ahead of the GitHub adapter be74
